title: Sitemap URL Extractor - Links, Lastmod & Nested Indexes
description: Example: {"sitemapUrls": ["https://docs.python.org/sitemap.xml"], "maxResults": 3}. Successful source parsing is billed, including zero-match checks; set maxTotalChargeUsd as an Apify run option.

sitemapUrls.title: Sitemap URLs
sitemapUrls.description: Pass 1–50 public sitemap URLs, e.g. ['https://docs.python.org/sitemap.xml']. Exact source URLs only; no website discovery. XML must be at most 8 MB decompressed. Successfully parsed sources are billed even when filters leave zero rows.

maxResults.title: Maximum output rows
maxResults.description: 1000 for URLs or 100 for entries by default. Caps delivered rows across all sources after filters. Reaching this cap stops further source requests.

sinceDate.title: Earliest date
sinceDate.description: Empty (default) keeps every date. Example: "2026-10-01" or "2026-10-01T12:00:00Z". Inclusive UTC cutoff on lastmod or publication date (updated date when publication is absent). Rows with missing or invalid dates are excluded when set. Source parsing is still billed.

urlContains.title: URL path or text filter
urlContains.description: [] (default) keeps all URLs. Example: ["/products/", "/blog/"] keeps URLs containing either literal substring, case insensitive. Filters apply before the result cap and URL billing; source parsing remains billed.

maxSources.title: Maximum sitemap files
maxSources.description: 30 (default), including index files, malformed responses and failed requests. Example: 5 limits processing to five unique source URLs. Nested indexes are followed breadth first; loops and repeated sources are skipped. Source fees apply only to successfully parsed files.

excludeIds.title: Previously returned IDs
excludeIds.description: [] (default) keeps all unseen rows within this run. Pass id values from an earlier dataset, e.g. ["previous-id"], to omit them. No state is remembered automatically. Source parsing remains billed even when every row is excluded.
